Docs.Title: Sec. 1-3. - Catchlines of sections.
Docs.Content: The catchlines of the several sections of this Code printed in boldface type are intended as mere catchwords to indicate the contents of the section, and unless otherwise expressly so provided, shall not be deemed or taken to be titles of such sections, or as any part of the section, nor, unless expressly so provided, shall they be so deemed when any of such sections, including the catchlines, are amended or reenacted.
